purpose: Reader-facing discovery layer for non-Mundarica Munda/Mundari sources. These are source leads, not extracted cultural claims and not proof of redistribution/commercial rights.

records.title: WALS Online — Language Mundari
records.notes: Mundari language profile and bibliography including Hoffmann 1903, Cook 1965, Gumperz & Biligiri 1957, Osada 1992 and others.

records.title: Mundari bibliography — ISFAS, Kiel University
records.notes: Bibliography lists Bhaduri 1931, Cook 1965, Das 1871, De Smet 1891, Hoffmann grammar and Encyclopaedia Mundarica, Hans 1942 Munda Durang, and later linguistic work.

records.title: Mundari language (Kherwari) — Online Books Page
records.notes: Catalogue leads for Mundari primer, grammars, Encyclopaedia Mundarica and Mundari texts, with external library links.
records.rights_note: Availability and reuse depend on linked repositories.

records.title: Hoffmann 1903 — Mundari Grammar
records.notes: Bibliographic record: Johann Hoffmann, Mundari Grammar, Calcutta, Bengal Secretariat Press, 1903; WALS links the work to Mundari typological datapoints.
records.rights_note: Bibliographic metadata; underlying book rights assessed separately.

records.title: The Changing Munda
records.notes: Sachchidananda, 1979, 361 pages; catalogue describes a study of cultural change among the Mundas and exposes contents/common-term metadata.
records.rights_note: Catalogue/search access does not establish full-text reuse rights.

records.title: Sarala (Tribhasi) Bhasha Sikshyana Pustika (Munda)
records.publisher: Ministry of Tribal Affairs repository / SCSTRTI & Special Development Council
records.notes: 2018 Munda trilingual/multilingual language book; repository record names Baneswar Munda, Muralidhar Munda and Singray Munda and exposes a PDF item.
records.rights_note: Repository availability does not by itself establish redistribution or commercial-reuse permission.

records.title: Some Munda Etymologies
records.notes: S. Bhattacharya; comparative Munda etymology article whose source list includes Encyclopaedia Mundarica and Bhaduri's 1931 Mundari-English Dictionary.
records.rights_note: Use locator for discovery/citation; rights assessed before redistribution.
